1;The Forgotten Battleground;1;7;PlanetNamesSpaces.txt;A great war was fought and lost here long ago.``Now a handful of alien factions vie for control`of the few remaining resources:``Opportunistic space pirates and the belligerent 'Gruff' are thorns in the side of the Bankers' trade empire and their Sigorn servants.``A criminal syndicate is trying to establish a foothold nearby...

en: 2;The Fringe Cluster;8;33;PlanetNamesGeneral.txt;Planets are somewhat more plentiful in this isolated group of stars.``The human resistance is gathering allies.`A variety of aliens are trying to make their home here, even though the Limoquee are waging war against the Vordalene.``Dunwiigu Monks follow their holy quest single-mindedly, while rumors say sinister forces are moving in...
ko: 2;변방 성단;8;33;PlanetNamesGeneral.txt;이 고립된 항성 무리에는 행성이 좀 더 많습니다.``인류 저항군이 동맹을 모으고 있습니다.`리모퀴가 보르달린과 전쟁을 벌이고 있는데도 여러 외계인이 이곳에 터전을 잡으려 합니다.``던위구 수도승들은 오로지 성스러운 탐구에만 매진하고, 불길한 세력이 몰려오고 있다는 소문이 돕니다...

en: 3;The Nightspan Void;34;43;PlanetNamesShort.txt;A barren zone separates more densely populated areas. Supplies dwindle in this interstellar wasteland. Who knows what alien factions hold sway here?
ko: 3;나이트스팬 공허;34;43;PlanetNamesShort.txt;척박한 지대가 인구가 밀집한 지역들을 갈라놓고 있습니다. 이 성간 황무지에서는 보급품이 줄어듭니다. 이곳을 어떤 외계 세력이 장악하고 있는지 누가 알겠습니까?

en: 4;The Stellar Aggregate;51;65;PlanetNamesLong.txt;A rich and tighly-packed sprawl of stars.
5;The XenoCouncil's Assembly;66;80;Planam_xenocouncil.txt;A great galactic governement once ruled here. No more.

en: 6;The Encroaching Lacuna;81;95;PlanetNamesShort.txt;Desolation ahead. Pass quickly and watch your supplies.

en: 7;The Great Boundary;96;124;PlanetNamesGeneral.txt;A mere smattering of stars compared to the galactic core beyond.

en: role=500^pers=1^step=0^~You're not who I was expecting. How did you get my package? ^#I found it among the remains of a poor unfortunate soul...=2 ^#I killed your courier and I took it!=1 ^#Does that really matter? I brought it to you.=2

en: role=500^pers=1^step=1^~I guess they weren't as tough as I thought. Maybe you'd like to be their replacement? I'm looking for something... ^#Depends what the job is=4 ^#No, I'm out of here=3
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=1^~생각만큼 센 녀석은 아니었나 보군요. 그럼 그 대신 일해 보실래요? 찾는 게 있거든요... ^#무슨 일인지에 따라서요=4 ^#싫어요, 전 이만 갈게요=3

en: role=500^pers=1^step=2^~Thank you for bringing it to me. I'll pay you. But let's talk more. I need someone capable like you to help me find something valuable. ^#Depends what the job is=4 ^#No, I'm out of here=3
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=2^~가져다주셔서 고마워요. 보수는 드릴게요. 그런데 얘기를 좀 더 하죠. 값진 걸 찾는 데 당신처럼 유능한 분의 도움이 필요해요. ^#무슨 일인지에 따라서요=4 ^#싫어요, 전 이만 갈게요=3

en: role=500^pers=1^step=3^~Come back if you change your mind, I've set up a small base here. ^#OK=4>end
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=3^~마음이 바뀌면 다시 오세요. 여기 작은 기지를 차려 뒀어요. ^#알겠어요=4>end

en: role=500^pers=1^step=4^~I'm @LGND.RelicHunterName the Relic Hunter.`I've been following the trail of the @LGND.ItemName for a long time now, and I'm getting close to finding it. ^#That's exciting!=5 ^#I'm not interested in that.=3

en: role=500^pers=1^step=5^~All right, let me look over the information you've just brought me... ^#OK=6

en: role=500^pers=1^step=6^~Just as I thought!`The @LGND.ItemName was created long ago by a @LGND.CreatorQuality @LGND.CreatorRace @LGND.CreatorOccupation called @LGND.CreatorName. ^#Go on...=7

en: role=500^pers=1^step=9^~Have you searched the wreckage on the planet's surface yet? ^#I'm still looking=9>end ^?qred#I have the final reports!=10>tiqu ^?!qst#Wait what?=9>quest=18101>end

en: role=500^pers=1^step=8^~The colony is abandoned now, some type of ecological disaster... but this prized possession may have been the subject of images, writing, or other accounts. Go see if you can find any trace of it. ^#I'll go right away=9>quest=18102>end
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=8^~그 식민지는 지금 버려졌어요. 무슨 생태 재앙이 있었대요... 하지만 이 귀중품이 그림이나 글, 다른 기록에 남아 있을지도 몰라요. 흔적이 있는지 가서 찾아봐 주세요. ^#바로 가 볼게요=9>quest=18102>end

en: role=500^pers=1^step=9^~Any luck investigating the ruins? ^#Nothing yet...=9>end ^?qred#Look what I found!=10>tiqu ^?!qst#Wait what?=9>quest=18102>end
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=9^~폐허 조사는 좀 진척이 있어요? ^#아직 아무것도...=9>end ^?qred#이것 좀 보세요!=10>tiqu ^?!qst#네? 뭐라고요?=9>quest=18102>end

en: role=500^pers=1^step=10^~Its amazing that so many people would squander such a powerful weapon. ^#I agree, let's find it!=30
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=10^~그렇게 많은 사람이 이런 강력한 무기를 허투루 썼다니 놀랍네요. ^#맞아요, 어서 찾죠!=30

en: role=500^pers=1^step=8^~Have you tracked down which race commisioned it yet? ^#I'm still looking=9 ^?qred#I found them!=10>tiqu ^?!qst#Wait what?=9>quest=18103>end
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=8^~어느 종족이 주문했는지 알아내셨어요? ^#아직 찾는 중이에요=9 ^?qred#찾았어요!=10>tiqu ^?!qst#네? 뭐라고요?=9>quest=18103>end

en: role=500^pers=1^step=9^~Keep hailing ships of different factions until you find the one that knows what we need. ^#I'm on it!=8>end
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=9^~우리가 필요한 걸 아는 세력이 나올 때까지 여러 세력의 함선에 계속 교신해 보세요. ^#맡겨 주세요!=8>end

en: role=500^pers=1^step=10^~I'll use this information to cross-reference in my searches. Good work. ^#What's next?=30
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=10^~이 정보로 제 조사 자료와 대조해 볼게요. 잘하셨어요. ^#다음은요?=30

en: role=500^pers=1^step=30^~I need some time to compare my notes with the information you've found. I'll send a coded transmission once I've made a plan. ^#What should I do until then?=31
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=30^~찾아 주신 정보와 제 기록을 맞춰 볼 시간이 좀 필요해요. 계획이 서면 암호 통신을 보낼게요. ^#그동안 전 뭘 하죠?=31

en: role=500^pers=1^step=31^~Follow up on whatever other business you have... Do some crafting, go cave-diving, explore some new areas maybe? ^#I'll be waiting for your call.=31 >clearsi=340 >clearsi=341 >setlegendbegun=31 &end
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=31^~하던 일이나 계속하세요... 제작도 좀 하고, 동굴 탐험도 하고, 새로운 곳도 좀 둘러보시든가요. ^#연락 기다릴게요.=31 >clearsi=340 >clearsi=341 >setlegendbegun=31 &end

en: role=500^pers=1^step=12^~Welcome back.`Now I'd like to follow another avenue of investigation, something to help us detect it at a distance. I want information on its energy signature. ^#How are we going to get that?=13
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=12^~어서 오세요.`이번엔 다른 방향으로 조사해 보고 싶어요. 멀리서도 그걸 탐지할 수 있게 해 줄 방법이요. 그것의 에너지 신호에 관한 정보가 필요해요. ^#그걸 어떻게 구하죠?=13

en: role=500^pers=1^step=14^~Deep underground. Here, I'll show you where to look. ^#Great. =15>quest=18201>end
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=14^~깊은 지하요. 자, 어디를 찾아봐야 하는지 알려 드릴게요. ^#좋아요. =15>quest=18201>end

en: role=500^pers=1^step=16^~Incredible. They're not very organized, or complete, but these will be a great help in detecting it. ^#What else should we try?=34
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=16^~굉장해요. 정리가 잘 되어 있거나 완전하진 않지만, 그걸 탐지하는 데 큰 도움이 될 거예요. ^#또 뭘 해 볼까요?=34

en: role=500^pers=1^step=14^~That compound is extremely rare. If you can collect enough, I'm sure I can develop some sort of tracking method. ^#I'll see what I can do=15>quest=18202>end
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=14^~그 화합물은 무척 희귀해요. 충분히 모아 주시면 분명 무슨 추적 방법을 개발할 수 있을 거예요. ^#해 볼게요=15>quest=18202>end

en: role=500^pers=1^step=16^~Yes, this will do! The fact that it's so rare will work in our favor. ^#Great! What comes next?=34
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=16^~네, 이거면 돼요! 워낙 희귀하다는 점이 오히려 우리한테 유리하게 작용할 거예요. ^#좋아요! 다음은요?=34

en: role=500^pers=1^step=14^~If you can find the creature's remains and scan them, we can learn the weapon's energy signature. ^#Where do I go?=15>quest=18203>end
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=14^~그 생물의 유해를 찾아 스캔해 주시면 무기의 에너지 신호를 알아낼 수 있어요. ^#어디로 가면 되죠?=15>quest=18203>end

en: role=500^pers=1^step=15^~Have you scanned the creature's remains yet? ^#I'll get to it...=15>end ^?qred#I have the energy signature!=16>tiqu ^?!qst#Wait what?=15>quest=18203>end
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=15^~그 생물의 유해는 스캔하셨어요? ^#곧 할게요...=15>end ^?qred#에너지 신호를 알아냈어요!=16>tiqu ^?!qst#네? 뭐라고요?=15>quest=18203>end

en: role=500^pers=1^step=16^~Great work! Now I can look for reports with similar characteristics. ^#Are we getting close?=34
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=16^~잘하셨어요! 이제 비슷한 특징이 있는 보고를 찾아볼 수 있어요. ^#거의 다 왔나요?=34

en: role=500^pers=1^step=33^~Now that I have a way to track it, it's time to crunch the numbers. Data analysis is one of my specialties, but it will be boring for you... ^#More waiting? =34
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=33^~이제 추적할 방법이 생겼으니 숫자를 돌려 볼 차례예요. 데이터 분석은 제 특기지만, 당신에겐 지루할 거예요... ^#또 기다려요? =34

en: role=500^pers=1^step=34^~That's right. Explore, talk to aliens, maybe chart a wormhole... Just do what you do and I'll be in touch. ^#Just like last time...=34 >clearsi=340 >clearsi=341 >setlegendbegun=33 &end
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=34^~맞아요. 탐험하고, 외계인과 얘기하고, 웜홀도 좀 찾아보시고... 하던 대로 하시면 제가 연락할게요. ^#지난번처럼요...=34 >clearsi=340 >clearsi=341 >setlegendbegun=33 &end

en: role=500^pers=1^step=17^~While you were gone, I found some information about a recent sighting of the item... Within the last year. ^#YEAR?!=18 ^#Sounds promising=19
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=17^~안 계신 동안, 그 물건이 최근에 목격됐다는 정보를 찾았어요... 1년 안쪽이에요. ^#1년이요?!=18 ^#희망적이네요=19

en: role=500^pers=1^step=18^~If this was going to be easy or quick I could do it myself. You've sped up the process tremendously, but there's still work to be done. ^#All right, let's get to it.=19
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=18^~쉽고 빠른 일이었다면 제가 직접 했겠죠. 당신 덕분에 엄청 빨라졌지만, 아직 할 일이 남았어요. ^#좋아요, 시작하죠.=19

en: role=500^pers=1^step=20^~It's a little out-of-the-way place not too far from here. You could easily miss it if you didn't know what to look for. ^#I'll go 'talk' to them.=21>quest=18301>end
ko: role=500^pers=1^step=20^~여기서 그리 멀지 않은, 조금 외진 곳이에요. 뭘 찾아야 하는지 모르면 그냥 지나치기 쉬워요. ^#가서 '대화'를 좀 나눠 볼게요.=21>quest=18301>end

en: role=500^pers=1^step=21^~Have you found the syndicate hideout yet? ^#I've been busy=21>end ^?qred#Done.=22>tiqu ^?!qst#Wait what?=21>quest=18301>end
role=500^pers=1^step=22^~I hope they didn't give you too much trouble. It won't be long now, I'm sure I can piece it together... ^#I'm excited=37 ^#It better be worth it=37

en: role=500^pers=1^step=24^~It's in the hands of a notorius criminal who is obsessed with collecting powerful weapons. And not just personal weapons like we're after, but big ship guns too. ^#Sounds dangerous.=25

en: role=500^pers=1^step=25^~Dead. They escaped in a life-pod, docked at a Gruff station, and got killed by their 'doctors'. But they didn't have the weapon... ^#How is that good news?=26

en: role=500^pers=1^step=26^~They must have hidden it on the ship, and planned to go back. Lucky for us, they never got the chance. Here's the info I have on the shipwreck. Go find it. ^#I'm on my way=27>quest=18403>end

en: role=500^pers=1^step=27^~Did you find it?! ^#Not yet=27>end ^?qred#Yes, look!=28>tiqu ^?!qst#Wait what?=27>quest=18403>end
